- prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt:68-71 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The prompt says a 60-minute target leaves headroom for retry even though the 3-hour budget only allows about one full 130-minute attempt.
  WHY: The wording is self-contradictory: it simultaneously claims only ~1 attempt fits and that the 60-minute target leaves retry headroom.
- prompts/mode-plan.txt:21-23 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]

  WHY: The wording is self-contradictory: it simultaneously claims only ~1 attempt fits and that the 60-minute target leaves retry headroom.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:1172-1180 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test does not cover the newly added success-no-op phrases in the implement.yml regex.
  WHY: It only asserts the old fragments and misses `satisfied`, `no repository changes`, and `no file changes made`, so a regression in those additions would still pass.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1017 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The exec-history extraction is brittle and can silently return nothing if the codex log format changes.
  WHY: The `awk '/^exec$/'` parser depends on an exact log shape and fails open without observability.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1013-1014 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `sort -u` reorders the extracted exec history alphabetically instead of preserving the order commands were tried.
  WHY: The retry prompt loses the chronological exploration sequence, reducing the usefulness of the history.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1013-1014 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Commands longer than 500 characters are dropped from exec-history extraction.
  WHY: The `length(cmd) < 500` guard silently omits legitimate long commands rather than truncating them.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:~620 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The corrective feedback hard-codes a reference to `prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt`, which can go stale if the prompt file moves or is renamed.
  WHY: The injected guidance depends on a file path outside the workflow, so it is maintainability-fragile.
- agents.md:~180 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The agents.md paragraph describes a retry-prompt exec-history persistence change in implement.yml that is not present in the last-run diff.
  WHY: The documentation may mislead operators about what changed in this run and where to look when troubleshooting retries.
- README.md:~140 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The README entry for `EDITOR_MAX_WALL` shows only the current value and omits the 3300→6600→7800 history documented in agents.md.
  WHY: Readers using the README as the quick reference miss the staged bump rationale and prior defaults.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
